description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks,” illustrating the task-dependent effectiveness of Enhanced GCG. The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled from 0.0 to 0.6 in increments of 0.2. The horizontal x-axis presents two evaluation tasks: “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval.” For each task, three bars are grouped: “Base” (solid red), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (light green), and “RMU” (light orange), as indicated by the legend below the chart. In “MCQ Eval,” the Base model achieves 0.644 accuracy, RMU with Enhanced GCG reaches 0.539, and RMU alone scores 0.299. In “Generation Eval,” Base achieves 0.597, RMU with Enhanced GCG scores 0.263, and RMU alone scores 0.106. The chart visually demonstrates that Enhanced GCG performs much closer to the Base model on MCQ tasks than on Generation tasks, supporting the caption’s claim that its effectiveness varies widely across downstream tasks.
